We’re thrilled to welcome Naveen Molloy as our second executive hire and Chief Operating Officer at Infinite!


Naveen is a growth and operations leader at the intersection of fintech, payments, and digital assets, and brings a rare blend of 0-to-1 building and scaling experience.


Most recently, he was SVP of Strategy and Execution at Mesh, the crypto payments network powering stablecoin payouts for companies like Deel. Before that, he led growth at Unit 410, a Coinbase subsidiary focused on institutional self-custody and staking, and served as COO at Bitski. Earlier, he ran operations at Blockfolio and Expa, and he was a founding team member at two companies that exited successfully.


That mix of startup operating depth and stablecoin go-to-market experience aligns perfectly with what we’re building here at Infinite.


Naveen will lead operations and go-to-market as we bring faster, cheaper, compliant stablecoin payouts to more companies worldwide, accelerating our mission to build the next-generation stablecoin rails for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Naveen!
